description: ISSUE-203, ADR-013 items 2-3, 15 §4.7, §4.10: a launch with both delegation gates on (the request carries a ticket-file DelegationInjection; row O2 mcpInjection ticket-file per the SP-12 foreman ruling of 2026-10-17). session/new carries the relay entry as a stdio MCP server named dwarfai whose own env holds only ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE and the credential file PATH; opencode's own argv and env hold neither, and no credential value and no DWARFAI_DELEGATION_TOKEN string is in any argv, env or frame (C-23, INV-59, INV-83). OpenCode acp has no pre-approval option, so nothing else is added to session/new (C-24). The agent side is the c-01-launch handshake (the recorded OpenCode 1.18.32 initialize and session/new answers): the agent's answers do not depend on mcpServers.
